title.zh: 微软与英伟达将在2026年发布首批搭载英伟达SoC的Windows PC
title.en: Sources: Microsoft and Nvidia will unveil the first Windows PCs powered by Nvidia SoCs, including devices from Surface and Dell, at Computex and Build 2026

summary.zh: 包括Surface和戴尔设备将在Computex和Build 2026上亮相。

title.zh: 微软GitHub Copilot将于6月1日转为基于令牌使用的计费模式
title.en: With Microsoft's GitHub Copilot shifting to token-usage billing on June 1, many developers bemoan massive cost increases and the end of flat-rate subscriptions

summary.zh: 开发者对成本大幅增加和固定费率订阅的终结表示不满。

title.zh: 软银承诺在法国投资高达750亿欧元建设AI计算集群
title.en: SoftBank pledges to invest up to €75B in AI computing clusters in France, first leading a €45B investment to build 3.1GW of capacity by 2031 in Hauts-de-France

summary.zh: 首期将主导450亿欧元投资，于2031年前在法国北部建成3.1GW容量。

title.zh: AI采用遵循通用技术的J曲线路径
title.en: AI adoption follows the J-curve path of general-purpose tech, like early US factory electrification, requiring years of investment before noticeable ROI gains

summary.zh: 类似于美国早期工厂电气化，需要多年投资后才能显现显著的投资回报。

title.en: Filing shows Shanghai-based MiniMax has begun preparations for a Chinese IPO; the AI company listed in Hong Kong in January and says its ARR has reached $300M

summary.zh: 该AI公司1月已在香港上市，年经常性收入达3亿美元。

title.zh: AI公司与美国FERC合作加速数据中心接入区域电网
title.en: Sources detail AI companies' engagement with US FERC as the energy regulator readies a June proposal to speed up data center connections to regional power grids

summary.zh: 能源监管机构计划在6月提出相关提案。

title.zh: 专家称ChatGPT和Gemini等AI模型助推伊朗网络攻击
title.en: Experts say ChatGPT, Gemini, and other Western AI models are turbocharging Iran's cyber operations, helping it develop malware and launch phishing attacks

summary.zh: 帮助其开发恶意软件并发起网络钓鱼攻击。

title.zh: 施耐德电气如何利用AI提升呼叫中心和制造业的生产力
title.en: How Schneider Electric is using AI in call centers and manufacturing to complement employees' work and boost productivity, rather than to replace them

summary.zh: 通过补充员工工作而非取代他们来提高效率。

title.zh: 存储芯片制造商通过长期协议重塑行业商业模式
title.en: Memory chip makers are leveraging their newfound power to secure long-term agreements, a move set to reshape the industry's business model and stabilize prices

summary.zh: 此举旨在稳定价格并改变行业格局。

title.zh: Garner Health完成1亿美元E轮融资，估值达27.4亿美元
title.en: NYC-based Garner Health, which uses data analytics to help 2.5M+ workers find physicians, raised a $100M Series E at a $2.74B valuation led by Index Ventures

summary.zh: 该公司利用数据分析帮助250万以上员工找到医生。

title.zh: 总部位于迈阿密的 Canals 获得 3500 万美元 A 轮融资，用 AI 自动化分销商工作流程
title.en: Miami-based Canals, which uses AI to help distributors automate workflows across sales, customer service, and more, raised a $35M Series A led by Base10

title.zh: PitchBook：全球机器人和物理 AI 的风投投资从 2019 年的 42 亿美元跃升至 2025 年的 260 亿美元
title.en: PitchBook: VC investment in global robotics and physical AI jumped to $26B in 2025 from $4.2B in 2019, and has already topped $23B as of May 20 this year

summary.zh: 截至今年 5 月 20 日，投资额已超过 230 亿美元。

title.zh: 美国机器人出租车公司在扩展过程中面临监管和公众批评
title.en: As robotaxi companies attempt to scale in the US, they face increasing scrutiny and mounting criticism from drivers, law enforcement, and local governments
